activationPopup.description: Activate Mokafaa now and start rewarding your customers instantly. By joining, you give your customers the ability to earn points on every purchase and redeem points directly in your store, boosting loyalty and driving repeat sales.
activationPopup.title: Mokafaa Activation

advantageOneDescription: Mokafaa is a loyalty program from Al Rajhi Bank that rewards customers with points for every purchase. By activating Mokafaa in your store, your customers can use their existing Mokafaa points to pay, or earn new points every time they shop.
advantageTwoDescription: Your customers can redeem their Mokafaa points at checkout to get discounts, or earn new points that increase their balance with every purchase. This makes shopping at your store more rewarding and keeps them coming back.
advantageTwoTitle: How will your customers benefit from Mokafaa in your store?
